set.body: From the features review (2026-08-28). Pre-existing for Aggregate.overTargets, extended by NarrativeBasis. Decide: fold a basis digest into derivationId (breaks stability of existing ids — needs a version bump) or make cache keys (derivationId, basisDigest). Paths: features/derivation.scala, window.scala, any cache in embed-core/features. Gate: features + codec all platforms.
set.title: features: derivationId does not cover the window basis (which units, what order) — same-id/different-basis tracks share an outputSpaceId; caches (§110) must key on basis identity too
